reviewer_scope: Independent review of parent-authored unlimited-timeout product changes; self-review of reviewer-authored registered-resume changes. No production or 31-minute Runtime pass claimed.
verified_contracts: Codex missing or explicit zero timeout remains zero through CLI, worker config, descriptor, planning, ExecutionSpec validation and Runtime context; no new deadline is introduced.
Positive explicit timeout still freezes DeadlineAt; AGY retains positive-only ExecutionSpec and 30-minute fallback.
Resolver keeps zero Codex default; finite policy MaxTimeout rejects unlimited execution.
Runtime uses cancellable parent context when no deadline; explicit frozen deadlines still apply, manual cancellation and existing shutdown/failure paths remain.

Registered resume requires owner lifecycle authentication and matching daemon/database installation, then exact current principal/org/name/role path/workspace/capabilities and canonical worker configuration. Bootstrap receipts cannot bypass identity checks and no receipt/DB repair is silently performed.

zero default retained; finite policy rejects unlimited; explicit47s retained

limitations: Registered profile stores a role path, not a permanently frozen role-content hash. Current role file must be readable/nonempty; per-Run content freezes remain authoritative.
Existing running Runs and explicit30m worker configurations retain prior settings until authorized deployment; unlimited default alone does not change them.
Pay damaged bootstrap receipt can still affect legacy status preparation until separately repaired; resume itself no longer parses it after authenticated identity validation.
31-minute real Runtime, exact running binary and deployed configuration verification remain with deployment harness.
